text: Yeah, but I'm not really a big fan of 40 reps of doing something. A 40-rep set would be more for CrossFit, maybe, or for high-raw athletes, and it's not necessarily more fat-burning. I don't really believe too much of that is something that people want to do, but it's optional. It can be put together into different styles of workouts, like maybe an AMRAP or things like that.
